1.0.0: Initial release. Boards: Create Board, Get Board, Find Boards, Update Board, Delete Board, Share Board. Items: Create Sticky Note, Create Card, Create Shape, Create Connector, List Items, Get Item, Delete Item. Make API Call. Polling triggers: New Board, Updated Board, New Item (Miro has no webhooks). OAuth 2.0 with expiring access tokens that are refreshed automatically.
1.0.1: List Items is replaced by Find Items: it filters by item type and has a Not Found output when nothing matches.
Find Boards and Find Items say that they return one page (at most 50) and that the filters narrow the result.
